future_check: After any profile or color-allocation change, verify every active column has k^2 cells and each bottom-to-top color run equals a consecutive whole-layer area partition.
rationale: The Racket rule converts a k-squared source column into bottom-aligned layers of widths 2k-1, 2k-3, ..., 1. Arbitrary counts or reordered source colors produce outputs that contradict the claimed input evidence even when the oracle remains executable.
summary: Generate only columns whose color counts partition complete odd-width pyramid layers.

future_check: Require 100% input uniqueness, all 108 ordinary output structures, balanced profile counts, and no loss of semantic witnesses after any diversity refactor.
rationale: Scattered source-row positions vary independently but are discarded by the transformation, so 600 audited inputs are unique while outputs repeat among 108 profile/color/layout structures. This is task semantics rather than collapse, but generic diversity logs still label duplicate outputs informationally.
summary: Ordinary generation has a deliberately finite structural output codomain despite fully unique sampled inputs.

future_check: Re-run the 32-window lesson audit after changing sample-index scheduling and require all 32 windows per band to remain identifiable.
rationale: The profiles jointly teach k=2 and k=3, one and two active columns, one/two/three color layer groups, scattered source rows, and all four canonical envelopes. A deterministic profile cycle makes every four-demo window complete without reducing seeded palette and layout variation.
summary: Use a four-consecutive-profile schedule so every lesson positively identifies all canonical structural branches.

future_check: Keep at least four malformed-but-executable probes whenever self_check or canonical-like logic changes.
rationale: All six adversarial recombinations execute in the Racket oracle, including all-background, singleton, incoherent counts, and overlapping output footprints. The strict teaching checker correctly rejects all six because they do not expose the canonical invariant.
summary: Racket non-crash on a malformed grid does not make that grid a valid teaching example.

future_check: After any Racket edit, require one selected hash across canonical and both target_code fields plus execution parity for every retained raw/target source.
rationale: The selected authority must have one stable hash, but the older raw program is useful provenance and independently solves all canonical pairs. Marking roles explicitly removes selection ambiguity without erasing historical source.
summary: Synchronize selected task-local target_code to canonical Racket while preserving the executable archival raw_code.
